arguments.sql:
WITH payment_links AS (
    SELECT p.payment_id, p.amount, p.rental_id, r.rental_id AS matched_rental,
           i.film_id AS inventory_film_id, f.film_id
    FROM main.payment AS p
    LEFT JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    LEFT JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    LEFT JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
),
film_totals AS (
    SELECT film_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM payment_links
    WHERE film_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY film_id
),
cast_counts AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS cast_size
    FROM main.film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id, fa.film_id, ft.total_revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY fa.actor_id
               ORDER BY ft.total_revenue DESC, fa.film_id
           ) AS film_rank
    FROM main.film_actor AS fa
    JOIN film_totals AS ft ON ft.film_id = fa.film_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.payment) AS payment_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS linked_rows_including_unmatched,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rental_id IS NULL) AS payments_without_rental_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL AND film_id IS NULL) AS broken_payment_paths,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount <> ROUND(amount, 2)) AS payments_beyond_cents,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.film) AS films,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_totals) AS films_with_payments,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_totals WHERE total_revenue <= 0) AS nonpositive_film_totals,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.actor) AS actors,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked WHERE film_rank = 3) AS actors_with_three_paid_films,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked WHERE film_rank <= 3) AS selected_films,
    (SELECT MIN(cc.cast_size) FROM ranked AS r
     JOIN cast_counts AS cc ON cc.film_id = r.film_id WHERE r.film_rank <= 3) AS smallest_selected_cast,
    (SELECT MAX(cc.cast_size) FROM ranked AS r
     JOIN cast_counts AS cc ON cc.film_id = r.film_id WHERE r.film_rank <= 3) AS largest_selected_cast,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked AS r
     JOIN ranked AS next ON next.actor_id = r.actor_id
         AND next.film_rank = r.film_rank + 1 AND next.total_revenue = r.total_revenue
     WHERE r.film_rank <= 3) AS ties_in_or_at_top_three
FROM payment_links

WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_revenue
    FROM main.payment AS p
    JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
cast_sizes AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS cast_size
    FROM main.film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id, fa.film_id, fr.total_revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY fa.actor_id
               ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC, fa.film_id
           ) AS film_rank,
           LEAD(fr.total_revenue) OVER (
               PARTITION BY fa.actor_id
               ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC, fa.film_id
           ) AS next_revenue
    FROM main.film_actor AS fa
    JOIN film_revenue AS fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
)
SELECT r.actor_id, r.film_rank, f.title, r.total_revenue, cs.cast_size,
       r.total_revenue / cs.cast_size AS revenue_per_actor,
       r.total_revenue = r.next_revenue AS tied_with_next
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = r.film_id
JOIN cast_sizes AS cs ON cs.film_id = r.film_id
WHERE r.film_rank <= 3
  AND (r.actor_id = 1 OR r.total_revenue = r.next_revenue)
ORDER BY r.actor_id, r.film_rank

       rf.total_revenue / cs.cast_size AS average_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films AS rf
JOIN main.actor AS a ON a.actor_id = rf.actor_id
JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = rf.film_id
JOIN cast_sizes AS cs ON cs.film_id = rf.film_id
WHERE rf.film_rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, rf.film_rank
LIMIT -1
